questions.question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship among the following classes.

Engineers, Indians, Ladies
questions.solution:
Given: Engineers, Indians, Ladies

The logic followed here is:

 
• Some ladies are engineers, some ladies are Indians, some Indians are engineers, and some ladies are both engineers and Indians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa179dedb21373a296b4452c6cb36fd2efa939dbc936a62455c2714b8bdd25ef.png] 

Hence, **option (4) **is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following Venn diagrams depicts the exact relationship between a polygon, a triangle and a rhombus?
questions.solution:
The Venn diagrams best represent the relationship between - a polygon, a triangle and a rhombus figure are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12a8e00c3b7e9dc8e4d36ef23aceb92ea9c10d6a497081e2c898f7744ecae50e.png] 

Both a triangle and a rhombus are polygon figures.

Hence, ‘option 2’ is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Rhombus** - The *meaning* of *rhombus* is a parallelogram with four equal sides and sometimes one with no right angles.

**Polygon** - A polygon is a closed shape with straight sides. Rectangles, triangles, hexagons, and octagons are all examples of polygons.

**Triangle** - A *triangle* is a closed, two-dimensional shape with three straight sides.
